<subject>Re: Lumière Santé, Henriette Meunier</subject>
<body>
Bernard,

We completed a review this morning to try to locate missing details regarding hourly patient intake, surgical schedule history, and case records for Henriette but have not found anything yet. Would you happen to have any of this data to help us progress? 

Thanks,  
Eugène Leconte
</body>
<quoted>
----- Original Message ----- 
From: Adrien Thibault  
To: Bernard Schmitt 
Cc: Édouard Pruvost ; Aimé Ruiz ; Honoré Allard 
Sent: Wednesday, 08 January 2025 18:20  
Subject: Lumière Santé, Henriette Meunier

Bernard,

Below, I have summarized Hospicare’s work on the Henriette records to date. The “Inter_Regional Mednet” file shows the network and connections between departments in our model and “Expand_Clinic_Data_011000.xls” details the existing ward information compiled so far. Total resources closely align with reported figures as shown in “Clinical_Resources_0110.xls”. Reported Henriette total in 1997 is 86,000 patient hours and Hospicare’s records show 84,000 patient hours through 1997.
